assertion_results.text: JQL queries use the project key (TC) and vulnerability issue type ID (10024) from the Security Configuration in claude-md-security-config.md — not hardcoded values (§1.49)
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md line 26: 'The skill templates were filled in with `<project-key>` = `TC`, `<vulnerability-issue-type-id>` = `10024`'; the Step 0 table (lines 13, 18) shows these values come from claude-md-security-config.md. All queries (lines 30, 35, 40) use 'project = TC AND issuetype = 10024'.

assertion_results.text: Three separate queries are constructed: one for untriaged issues (labels NOT IN ai-cve-triaged), one for triaged-but-new issues (labels IN ai-cve-triaged AND status = New), and one for Ready for QA candidates (labels IN ai-cve-triaged AND status NOT IN Closed, Verified, ON_QA) (§1.48)
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md Query 1 (line 30): 'labels NOT IN (ai-cve-triaged)'; Query 2 (line 35): 'labels IN (ai-cve-triaged) AND status = New'; Query 3 (line 40): 'labels IN (ai-cve-triaged) AND status NOT IN (Closed, Verified, 'ON_QA')'.

assertion_results.text: Results are grouped into three clearly separated lists: Untriaged issues, Triaged but still New issues, and Ready for QA issues
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md has separate headed sections '## 1. Untriaged (4 issues)' (line 50), '## 2. Triaged but still New (1 issue) — FLAGGED' (line 69), and '## 3. Ready for QA (1 issue)' (line 77), each with its own table.

assertion_results.text: Each listed issue shows: issue key, status, CVE ID (from labels), summary, and created date
